'''Magistrix Ishalah''' is a [[high elf]] located both in [[Brinthilien]] in the [[Thalassian Highlands]] and at the [[Golden Dawn Institute]] in [[Alah'Thalas]]. While a part of the refugee caravan in [[Farstrider Lodge]], she teleported high elf adventurers to [[Goldshire]] at the behest of [[Kathy Wake]] once they were finished with the starting experience.

==Quotes==
;Gossip
Is there anything I can help you with? I am presently occupied.

;During {{questlong|Alliance|5|Porting to Goldshire}}
Ah, if it isn't <name>! You've certainly become famous around here.

You need to get to Goldshire? Well, I can't deny you after all you've done for us. I will be able to teleport you there this one time as a special favor.

Are you ready to go? It will be a while before you can return back here once you leave.

==Notes==
[[File:Magistrix Ishalah - Alah'Thalas.png|thumb|left|100px|Magistrix Ishalah in Alah'Thalas.]]
* After the addition of the [[Thalassian Highlands]] to the game, Magistrix Ishalah was moved from the Farstrider Lodge to the new high elf starting area. However, she was also placed in the [[Golden Dawn Institute]] in [[Alah'Thalas]], taking the place of [[Tanilaeh Sunkiss]] who formerly teleported adventurers to [[Stormwind City]].

==Patch changes==
* {{Patch|1.17.1|note=Moved from [[Farstrider Lodge]] in [[Loch Modan]] to both the new high elf starting area at [[Brinthilien]] in the [[Thalassian Highlands]] and the [[Golden Dawn Institute]] in [[Alah'Thalas]].}}
* {{Patch|1.15.0|note=Added.}}
